title: Hidden Ocean on Mars

scenes.title: Setting the Stage
scenes.setting: A desolate, dusty landscape of Mars with red rocks and Olympus Mons in the distance.
scenes.summary: A young astronaut, Ava, lands on Mars and discovers an old Martian map indicating a potential water source. She sets up her equipment, filled with excitement for her mission.

scenes.title: The Journey Begins
scenes.setting: A rocky Martian canyon, shadows stretching as the sun begins to set.
scenes.summary: Ava navigates through the canyon, following the map. She hears a strange sound resembling rushing water, heightening her anticipation of finding water on Mars.

scenes.title: The Discovery
scenes.setting: A hidden cavern illuminated by bioluminescent algae, revealing a vast underground ocean.
scenes.summary: Ava discovers the underground ocean, glowing softly and filled with strange aquatic life. She collects samples and captures holographic images, overwhelmed by the beauty of her find.

scenes.title: Confronting the Decision
scenes.setting: Back at the canyon entrance, under a starry Martian sky.
scenes.summary: Ava reflects on her discovery and debates whether to reveal the ocean's location. She feels the weight of her responsibility as a scientist and explorer.

scenes.title: A Choice Made
scenes.setting: The entrance of her spacecraft, with the Martian landscape behind her.
scenes.summary: Ava decides to keep the ocean a secret to preserve its beauty. She sends a report back to Earth, omitting the ocean's location, and lifts off from Mars with a sense of fulfillment.

premise: A young astronaut discovers a hidden ocean on Mars.
setting_description: A visually stunning Martian landscape featuring red rocks, canyons, and a hidden underground ocean.
